value.content: {"id": "portswigger_api_testing", "item_type": "methodology", "topic": "api_testing", "category": "PortSwigger Web Security: API Testing & Mass Assignment", "name": "API Testing, OpenAPI Schema Inconsistencies & Mass Assignment Methodology", "cwe": "CWE-915", "owasp_category": "A01:2021 - Broken Access Control", "signals": ["openapi_swagger_json_exposed", "hidden_api_parameters", "mass_assignment_object_binding", "http_method_override_accepted", "unsupported_media_type_bypass"], "verification_strategy": "Discover undocumented endpoints and schema definitions (/swagger.json, /openapi.json, /api/v1/docs). Fuzz for hidden administrative parameters (e.g. isAdmin, role, approved) using mass assignment in PUT/PATCH requests. Test HTTP verb overriding (X-HTTP-Method-Override: PUT) to bypass access filters.", "evidence_requirements": ["swagger_schema_definition", "mass_assignment_privilege_mutation", "method_override_response_delta"], "tools": [{"tool": "kiterunner", "cmd": "kr scan https://api.example.com -A=apiroutes-260227:10000 -x 8", "desc": "Fast API routing & hidden endpoint brute-force based on asset wordlists"}, {"tool": "arjun", "cmd": "arjun -u 'https://api.example.com/users/update' -m JSON", "desc": "Discovers hidden HTTP request parameters across REST APIs"}], "remediation": "Do not bind HTTP request bodies directly to internal database domain models (mass assignment). Use explicit Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) defining allowed fields. Require authorization on all API routes.", "description": "PortSwigger API Testing curriculum addresses discovering hidden API documentation, identifying unpublished endpoints, exploiting mass assignment to grant administrative privileges, and bypassing server-side input filters."}
